death.note: As printed by days.pravoslavie.ru: “Прп. Аристоклия, старца Московского (1918)”.

feast.note: The Sretensky day prints «Прп. Аристоклия, старца Московского (1918)». The corpus held him twice, once for each calendar, as «Όσιος Αριστοκλής ο Αθωνίτης» and once as «Прп. Аристоклия, старца Московского»; the author ruled on 3 October 2026 that they are one man (TODO item 13 row 11) and this record is the merge. It is not a doubt: both lives carry the same man — Alexis Amvrosiev of Orenburg, born 1846, Athos in 1876, tonsured Aristocles in 1880, the Moscow metochion, dead 24 August 1918, moved to the Danilov in 1923, glorified 2001.

source.text: Православный церковный календарь, Сретенский монастырь (days.pravoslavie.ru), 24 августа ст. ст. — «Прп. Аристоклия, старца Московского (1918)»

attestations.note: Not on doxologia.ro’s list for 24 august, checked under both name forms (2026-08-22 and 2026-08-23); no other day checked.

feast.note: The same day on the Greek calendar, kept as «Όσιος Αριστοκλής ο Αθωνίτης», the Athonite rather than the Muscovite. The corpus held him twice, once for each calendar, as «Όσιος Αριστοκλής ο Αθωνίτης» and once as «Прп. Аристоклия, старца Московского»; the author ruled on 3 October 2026 that they are one man (TODO item 13 row 11) and this record is the merge. It is not a doubt: both lives carry the same man — Alexis Amvrosiev of Orenburg, born 1846, Athos in 1876, tonsured Aristocles in 1880, the Moscow metochion, dead 24 August 1918, moved to the Danilov in 1923, glorified 2001.

source.text: Ορθόδοξος Συναξαριστής (saint.gr), 24 Αυγούστου — «Όσιος Αριστοκλής ο Αθωνίτης»

attestations.note: Not on the Православни подсетник’s calendar line for 06.09.2026 (24. август ст. ст.), nor in its Ohrid Prologue for that day (pravoslavno.rs, checked 2026-08-23).
